one_liner: Ranks every number by a repeating 4-draw cycle in its returns, on top of the general effect of absence.
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_19 looks at how long each number has been away since it was last drawn. It looks for a repeating 4-draw cycle in how long each number stays away, for example from draw machines or ball sets used in turn. It starts from E_17's estimate for the present absence and multiplies it by the number's own cycle factor, shrunk towards all numbers' factor and with the number's overall rate divided out. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 104 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
